description:
Two side-by-side satellite images of the same geographic area in Sweden, acquired by Spot 5, depicting land cover for CORINE Land Cover (CLC) classification. The image on the left is a raw infrared orthophoto, showing an agricultural and forested landscape with varying shades of red, magenta, and dark green indicating different vegetation types and bare earth. The image on the right is the same orthophoto with superimposed white polygons delineating CLC land cover units, along with their corresponding three-digit CLC codes.

The central, large, dark green area, characterized by linear trench and parcel structures, is labelled `412`, which corresponds to "Peat bogs" based on CORINE nomenclature and the surrounding document context describing "Exploited peat bogs." Surrounding this central area are polygons labelled:
*   `211`: Non-irrigated arable land
*   `231`: Pastures
*   `243`: Land principally occupied by agriculture, with significant areas of natural vegetation
*   `311`: Broad-leaved forest

The delineation of these polygons is attributed to CORINE Land Cover, fairing with the satellite image situation. The imagery credit is ESA.
